title: Fugal has seen UFOs in the air himself
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Fugal has seen UFOs in the air himself, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've seen them myself in the air. I mean, right.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he has seen UFOs flying in the sky with his own eyes. He does not say where or when. He tells it to make clear that he is not just repeating other people's reports.
